sources.snippet: Read our How to Run Qwen-Image Guide! 💜 This is a GGUF quantized version of Qwen-Image-Edit-2511. unsloth/Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-GGUF uses Unsloth Dynamic 2.0 methodology for SOTA performance. Important layers are upcasted to higher precision. Uses tooling from ComfyUI-GGUF by city96. For more information on how to use and run the model in ComfyUI, read our guide.

sources.snippet: Overview Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-GGUF is a quantized inference-optimized version of Alibaba's Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 image editing model, maintained by unsloth. This model performs inpainting and guided image-to-image transformations using text prompts as direction, accepting one or multiple input images alongside natural language descriptions to produce edited outputs.
